in_marathi.name: Dakshina
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Offering to a teacher or priest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dakshina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dakshina refers to an offering made to a teacher or priest, often in the form of money, but also could be in the form of respect or gratitude.
